Taylor Fritz: Taylor Fritz enters his upcoming match following a recent defeat at the Paris Masters, where he squandered match points against Carlos Alcaraz to miss out on ATP Finals qualification. Prior to that loss, which followed his 100th Masters 1000 win over Arthur Fils, Fritz learned his Stockholm draw where he is set to face Cameron Norrie.
Holger Rune: Holger Rune recently returned to Stockholm—the site of his horrific and scary Achilles injury from 2025—with a statement opening win. He followed this up by defeating Miomir Kecmanovic to reach his 40th career quarter-final, showing strong early form at the venue.
Ugo Humbert: Ugo Humbert started his Stockholm title hunt by avoiding an upset against Adolfo Daniel Vallejo, surviving nine breaks to reach the second round. He has now set up a last-16 clash in the tournament against qualifier Borna Gojo.
Lorenzo Musetti: Lorenzo Musetti enters this match in strong form, having recently defeated Alexander Zverev at the Paris Masters before easing past Toby Samuel to reach the quarterfinals at the Stockholm Open.
